cases.title: Local council debates new park hours
cases.content:
# Local council debates new park hours

The city council met on Tuesday to discuss extending opening hours for public parks over the summer.

Residents shared mixed opinions during the public comment period, with some welcoming longer evenings outdoors and others raising concerns about noise and lighting.

A vote is expected at the next session.
